logistic_regression.notes: Best tabular baseline, strict chronological partition

xgboost.notes: Second-best tabular, SHAP feature analysis available

uncertainty_aware_rnn_mc_dropout.notes: MDPI Jan 2026 — rolling-form indicators + shot-chart spatial embeddings + MC dropout. GPU required.

gap_analysis.verdict: We beat CNN SOTA. Main gap vs LR/XGBoost: (1) no shot-chart spatial features, (2) limited rolling-form momentum explicitly encoded, (3) no MC dropout calibration (isotonic only in Colab).

key_sota_features: shot_chart_zone_efficiency — spatial shot distribution (requires shot log data)

proposals.description: Add explicit 5-game momentum feature category to engine.py: team_win_streak, team_momentum_5g, team_pts_diff_momentum_5g, opp_momentum_5g. All computable from nba_cached_data.npz game history.
proposals.effort: low — add 4 derived columns to engine.py feature category block

proposals.description: Port xgboost_brier custom Brier loss objective from political islands to NBA island mutation pool. Political P2 uses it and leads at 0.24997. NBA islands primarily use extra_trees/RF/catboost — xgboost_brier objective could push through current floor.
proposals.effort: medium — add to island model_type mutation candidates

proposals.description: Add isotonic regression post-hoc calibration to evolution island evaluation loop (currently only in Colab TabICL). Colab calibrated best 0.22054 vs uncalibrated 0.22169 — ~0.001 gain.
Verify back_to_back and rest_days features are present in island populations. SOTA consistently ranks these top-10. Confirm in engine.py audit.

cross_project_port_summary.nba_to_political: Momentum features → political_entity_momentum_score: rolling approval trend, party vote consistency rolling, market-implied momentum (Kalshi 30d). P7 LR result validates linear momentum signal dominance.
cross_project_port_summary.political_to_nba: xgboost_brier objective. P2 political at 0.24997 using it. Add to NBA island model_type mutation pool.
